name: Sushi Bar Yellowtail Sashimi (Hamachi Slices, Plain)
whyItWorks: Buttery, tender slices of Pacific yellowtail without rice, seaweed, or sauces. Delivers pure, delicate marine protein and healthy fats with zero digestive residue or fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Hamachi Sashimi plain—NO jalapeño slices, NO ponzu citrus sauce, NO daikon radish garnish.' Dip in tamari.
